subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Citroën DS
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Citroën DS.

hook.text: When the Citroën DS debuted in 1955, people thought it came from another planet.

buildup.text: Its aerodynamic body, hydropneumatic suspension, and swiveling headlights were decades ahead of rivals.

discovery.text: It received 749 orders in the first 15 minutes of its Paris Motor Show debut and 12,000 on day one.

twist.text: The DS was so complex that most mechanics couldn't fix it. Hydraulic leaks were constant and maddening.

climax.text: Roland Barthes compared it to a gothic cathedral. It remains one of the most celebrated car designs ever.

punchline.text: The DS was a spaceship that arrived 20 years too early.

quiz.question: How many orders did the DS receive on its first day?

details.summary: The Citroen DS, unveiled in 1955, stunned the world with its aerodynamic body, hydropneumatic self-leveling suspension, and swiveling headlights, receiving 12,000 orders on its first day of display.
details.whyItMatters: The DS was decades ahead of its time. It proved that mainstream cars could incorporate radical technology and design, setting standards that competitors would not match for years.
takeaways: Hydropneumatic suspension gave it a magic-carpet ride quality
The DS received 12,000 orders on its first day at the Paris show
Its streamlined body had a drag coefficient remarkably low for 1955

faq.question: What made the DS so revolutionary?
faq.answer: It combined a futuristic body with hydraulic power for suspension, braking, steering, and gear shifting. Nothing else on the road came close to its level of engineering sophistication for a family car.

faq.question: How long was the DS in production?
faq.answer: It was produced from 1955 to 1975, remarkably long for a car so advanced. Over 1.4 million were sold, and it remains one of the most celebrated automotive designs in history.
